import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX_N = 205;
    static final int MAX_M = MAX_N * MAX_N;
    
    static int[] prev_edge = new int[MAX_M];
    static int[] visited_node = new int[MAX_N];
    static int[] adj_head = new int[MAX_N];
    static int[] edge_src = new int[MAX_M];
    static int[] edge_cap = new int[MAX_M];
    static int[] edge_dst = new int[MAX_M];
    static int edge_idx = 0;
    
    static int[][] input_grid = new int[MAX_N][MAX_N];
    static int[][] output_grid = new int[MAX_N][MAX_N];
    static int[][] red_mark = new int[MAX_N][MAX_N];
    static int[][] block_mark = new int[MAX_N][MAX_N];
    static int[][] dist_map = new int[MAX_N][MAX_N];
    static int[] red_dist = new int[MAX_N];
    static int[] bfs_seen = new int[MAX_N];
    static int[][] bfs_q = new int[MAX_N][2];
    
    static final int[] dx = {0, -1, 0, 1};
    static final int[] dy = {1, 0, -1, 0};
    
    static void linkEdge(int u, int v, int uv_cap, int vu_cap) {
        edge_src[edge_idx] = u;
        edge_dst[edge_idx] = v;
        edge_cap[edge_idx] = uv_cap;
        prev_edge[edge_idx] = adj_head[u];
        adj_head[u] = edge_idx;
        edge_idx++;
        edge_src[edge_idx] = v;
        edge_dst[edge_idx] = u;
        edge_cap[edge_idx] = vu_cap;
        prev_edge[edge_idx] = adj_head[v];
        adj_head[v] = edge_idx;
        edge_idx++;
    }
    
    static int dfsFlow(int node, int target, int flow) {
        if (node == target) return flow;
        if (visited_node[node] != 0) return 0;
        visited_node[node] = 1;
        for (int e = adj_head[node]; e != -1; e = prev_edge[e]) {
            if (edge_cap[e] > 0) {
                int next_node = edge_dst[e];
                int flow_pushed = dfsFlow(next_node, target, Math.min(flow, edge_cap[e]));
                if (flow_pushed > 0) {
                    edge_cap[e] -= flow_pushed;
                    edge_cap[e ^ 1] += flow_pushed;
                    return flow_pushed;
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }
    
    static int maxFlow(int src, int dst) {
        int total = 0;
        for (;;) {
            Arrays.fill(visited_node, 0);
            int delta = dfsFlow(src, dst, 2000000000);
            total += delta;
            if (delta == 0) break;
        }
        return total;
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int dt = sc.nextInt();
        
        Arrays.fill(adj_head, -1);
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_N; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(dist_map[i], 63);
            dist_map[i][i] = 0;
        }
        
        for (int x = 0; x < n; x++) {
            String line = sc.next();
            for (int y = 0; y < n; y++) {
                char c = line.charAt(y);
                if (c == 'Y') block_mark[x][y] = 1;
                else if (c == 'Z') red_mark[x][y] = 1;
                else input_grid[x][y] = c - '0';
            }
        }
        
        for (int x = 0; x < n; x++) {
            String line = sc.next();
            for (int y = 0; y < n; y++) {
                char c = line.charAt(y);
                if (c != 'Y' && c != 'Z') {
                    output_grid[x][y] = c - '0';
                    for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                        int nx = x + dx[d];
                        int ny = y + dy[d];
                        if (nx >= 0 && ny >= 0 && nx < n && ny < n && 
                            block_mark[nx][ny] == 0 && red_mark[nx][ny] == 0) {
                            dist_map[x * n + y][nx * n + ny] = 1;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        int node_count = n * n;
        for (int k = 0; k < node_count; k++) {
            for (int i = 0; i < node_count; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < node_count; j++) {
                    if (dist_map[i][k] + dist_map[k][j] < dist_map[i][j]) {
                        dist_map[i][j] = dist_map[i][k] + dist_map[k][j];
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        int qf = 0, qr = 0;
        Arrays.fill(red_dist, 63);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (red_mark[i][j] == 1) {
                    bfs_q[qr][0] = i;
                    bfs_q[qr][1] = j;
                    qr++;
                    red_dist[i * n + j] = 0;
                }
            }
        }
        
        while (qf != qr) {
            int x = bfs_q[qf][0];
            int y = bfs_q[qf][1];
            qf++;
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                int nx = x + dx[d];
                int ny = y + dy[d];
                if (nx >= 0 && ny >= 0 && nx < n && ny < n && 
                    block_mark[nx][ny] == 0 && red_mark[nx][ny] == 0 && 
                    red_dist[nx * n + ny] > 1000000000) {
                    red_dist[nx * n + ny] = red_dist[x * n + y] + 1;
                    bfs_q[qr][0] = nx;
                    bfs_q[qr][1] = ny;
                    qr++;
                }
            }
        }
        
        int sink_node = MAX_N - 1;
        int source_node = MAX_N - 2;
        
        for (int start_node = 0; start_node < node_count; start_node++) {
            Arrays.fill(bfs_seen, 0);
            qf = 0;
            qr = 0;
            int sx = start_node / n;
            int sy = start_node % n;
            if (block_mark[sx][sy] == 1 || red_mark[sx][sy] == 1) continue;
            bfs_q[qr][0] = sx;
            bfs_q[qr][1] = sy;
            qr++;
            bfs_seen[start_node] = 1;
            while (qf != qr) {
                int x = bfs_q[qf][0];
                int y = bfs_q[qf][1];
                qf++;
                if (dist_map[start_node][x * n + y] <= dt) {
                    linkEdge(start_node << 1, (x * n + y) << 1 | 1, 1000, 0);
                }
                if (dist_map[start_node][x * n + y] == red_dist[x * n + y]) continue;
                for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                    int nx = x + dx[d];
                    int ny = y + dy[d];
                    int nid = nx * n + ny;
                    if (nx >= 0 && ny >= 0 && nx < n && ny < n && 
                        block_mark[nx][ny] == 0 && red_mark[nx][ny] == 0 && 
                        dist_map[start_node][nid] <= red_dist[nid] && 
                        dist_map[start_node][nid] <= dt && 
                        dist_map[start_node][nid] > dist_map[start_node][x * n + y] && 
                        bfs_seen[nid] == 0) {
                        bfs_q[qr][0] = nx;
                        bfs_q[qr][1] = ny;
                        qr++;
                        bfs_seen[nid] = 1;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < node_count; i++) {
            linkEdge(source_node, i << 1, input_grid[i / n][i % n], 0);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < node_count; i++) {
            linkEdge((i << 1) | 1, sink_node, output_grid[i / n][i % n], 0);
        }
        
        System.out.println(maxFlow(source_node, sink_node));
    }
}
